name: Five-layer diffusion, constant diffusivity per layer
status_basis: STRATO v1.0 solves the layered equation by finite volume (Code B) and by an eigenfunction series (Code C); the tests show second-order convergence in space, first-order convergence in time, a balance residual at round-off level and agreement of the two codes on the synthetic five-layer case. Verification only: no comparison with measurements exists.
required_parameters: layer outer radii (registered: inputs/synthetic/synthetic_five_layer.toml);layer diffusivities (registered: inputs/synthetic/synthetic_five_layer.toml);kernel start concentration (registered: inputs/synthetic/synthetic_five_layer.toml)
missing_work: A comparison with measured release needs temperature-dependent diffusivity (web phase 6.2) and the validation of web phase 7.

name: Fission-product generation

name: Radioactive decay

name: Inventory accounting with decay and source

name: Temperature-dependent diffusivity
status_basis: Derived in the Phase 2 derivations (P22.1, P22.11, P22.14, P22.15) and written as pseudocode; diffusivity rows and temperature histories are registered. No Rust code exists.
missing_work: Rust implementation of (P22.15) with the step-average diffusivity of option A (owner decision D8), the Arrhenius and temperature cases of the pseudocode Section 7.2 and an independent review (web phase 6.2).

name: Layer-specific temperature laws
status_basis: Each layer has its own Arrhenius coefficients in (P22.1); Section 5.4 of the Phase 2 derivations derives what changes when the layers follow different laws. No Rust code exists.
required_parameters: Arrhenius coefficients of each of the five layers (registered: data/diffusivity/arrhenius.csv);UCO kernel coefficients (missing: the registered kernel rows are for UO2)
missing_work: Rust evaluation of one Arrhenius law per layer inside the conductances (P22.14), with the UO2-for-UCO kernel assumption labelled wherever it is used (rule E3) (web phase 6.2).

name: Interface partition coefficients
status_basis: Not in the model: STRATO v1.0 and the Phase 2 derivations assume perfect contact with no partition coefficient (assumption A2).
missing_work: A derivation of interface conditions with partition ratios, registered partition data with sources and a decision to add them to the model.
